mapper.select: SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE PRODG IS NOT NULL AND CHIPBODY IS NOT NULL AND FLAG='Y' ORDER BY PRODG,CHIPBODY
mapper.update: UPDATE A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN SET FLAG='N',TD_UPDATE_TIME=SYSDATE,TD_UPDATE_USER=#{updateUser} WHERE PRODG = #{prodg} AND CHIPBODY= #{chipbody}

MERGE INTO A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN A USING ( SELECT A.*,CASE WHEN A.INPUT_ACTUAL>200 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END FLAG FROM ( SELECT PRODG1,SUM(INPUT_ACTUAL) INPUT_ACTUAL FROM ( SELECT PRODG1,INPUT_ACTUAL,SHIFT_DATE FROM PWEB.WAFER_IO_QUARTERLY UNION ALL SELECT PRODG1,INPUT_ACTUAL,SHIFT_DATE FROM PWEB.WAFER_IO_QUARTERLY@TO_A3PDW ) WHERE SHIFT_DATE <TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24,'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY PRODG1 )A )B ON (A.PRODG=B.PRODG1) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG =B.FLAG,A.INPUT_ACC = B.INPUT_ACTUAL,A.SYS_UPDATE_TIME=SYSDATE WHERE A.IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG IS NULL AND A.INPUT_ACC IS NULL AND A.FLAG='Y'
UPDATE A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN A SET A.IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG ='否',A.INPUT_ACC =0,A.SYS_UPDATE_TIME=SYSDATE WHERE A.IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG IS NULL AND A.INPUT_ACC IS NULL AND A.FLAG='Y'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT PRODG PRODG_VALUE,PRODG PRODG_LABEL FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE FLAG='Y' AND IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG IS NOT NULL AND FAB IS NOT NULL ) WHERE PRODG_VALUE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PRODG_LABEL
mapper.update: MERGE INTO A1MFG.NTO_MFG_MAINTAIN A USING ( SELECT #{prodg} AS PRODG, #{chipbody} AS CHIPBODY, #{eqpg} AS EQP_G, #{eqplist} AS EQP_ID, #{updateUser} UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL ) B ON (A.PRODG = B.PRODG AND A.CHIPBODY=B.CHIPBODY AND A.EQP_G=B.EQP_G) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.EQP_ID=B.EQP_ID,A.UPDATE_TIME=SYSDATE,A.UPDATE_USER=B.UPDATE_USER WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PRODG,CHIPBODY,EQP_G,EQP_ID,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER) VALUES (B.PRODG,B.CHIPBODY,B.EQP_G,B.EQP_ID,SYSDATE,B.UPDATE_USER)
UPDATE A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN SET FAB=#{fab},PMC_UPDATE_TIME=SYSDATE,PMC_UPDATE_USER=#{updateUser} WHERE PRODG=#{prodg} AND CHIPBODY=#{chipbody}

UNION ALL

) )B WHERE 1=1)C LEFT JOIN A1MFG.NTO_MFG_MAINTAIN D ON C.PRODG=D.PRODG AND C.CHIPBODY=D.CHIPBODY AND C.EQP_G=D.EQP_G ORDER BY C.EQP_G

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT NVL(B.COMMON_ID,A.EQP_ID) PRODG_VALUE,NVL(B.COMMON_ID,A.EQP_ID) PRODG_LABEL FROM (
SELECT T.EQP_G ,CASE WHEN T.EQP_G LIKE 'E%' AND SUBSTR(T.EQP_G,1,6) NOT IN ('EA_KEM','EB_KEM') THEN T.EQP_ID ELSE SUBSTR(T.EQP_ID,1,5) END EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD T WHERE T.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' AND (
(SUBSTR(T.EQP_G,1,6) IN ('EA_KEM','EB_KEM') AND ((T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='--') OR (T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='EQP' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')))
OR
(T.EQP_G LIKE 'E%' AND SUBSTR(T.EQP_G,1,6) NOT IN ('EA_KEM','EB_KEM') AND T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')
OR
(T.EQP_G NOT LIKE 'E%' AND T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='--')
OR (T.EQP_G NOT LIKE 'E%' AND T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')
OR
(T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='EQP' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')
) AND EQP_G=#{eqpg}
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'QC_OCD' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE EQP_G IN ('QC_THK','QC_THK_Cu') UNION ALL SELECT 'QC_THK' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK_Cu') UNION ALL SELECT 'QC_THK_Cu' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK') UNION ALL SELECT 'QW_SEM-PH' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE EQP_G IN ('QW_SEM-ET') UNION ALL SELECT 'QW_SEM-ET' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD WHERE EQP_G IN ('QW_SEM-PH') ) WHERE EQP_G=#{eqpg}
UNION ALL
SELECT T.EQP_G ,CASE WHEN T.EQP_G LIKE 'E%' AND SUBSTR(T.EQP_G,1,6) NOT IN ('EA_KEM','EB_KEM') THEN T.EQP_ID ELSE SUBSTR(T.EQP_ID,1,6) END EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 T WHERE T.ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' AND (
(SUBSTR(T.EQP_G,1,6) IN ('EA_KEM','EB_KEM') AND ((T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='--') OR (T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='EQP' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')))
OR
(T.EQP_G LIKE 'E%' AND SUBSTR(T.EQP_G,1,6) NOT IN ('EA_KEM','EB_KEM') AND T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')
OR
(T.EQP_G NOT LIKE 'E%' AND T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='--')
OR (T.EQP_G NOT LIKE 'E%' AND T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='Chamber' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')
OR
(T.EQP_CHAMBER_FLAG='EQP' AND MIN_UNIT_FLAG='Y')
) AND EQP_G=#{eqpg}
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'QC_OCD' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 WHERE EQP_G IN ('QC_THK','QC_THK_Cu') UNION ALL SELECT 'QC_THK' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 WHERE EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK_Cu') UNION ALL SELECT 'QC_THK_Cu' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 WHERE EQP_G IN ('QC_OCD','QC_THK') UNION ALL SELECT 'QW_SEM-PH' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 WHERE EQP_G IN ('QW_SEM-ET') UNION ALL SELECT 'QW_SEM-ET' EQP_G,EQP_ID FROM PWEB.EQP_ID_USE_STD_A3 WHERE EQP_G IN ('QW_SEM-PH') UNION ALL SELECT 'QA_AEI' EQP_G,'QAN301' EQP_ID FROM DUAL ) WHERE EQP_G=#{eqpg}
)A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LINE, KEY1 AS MODULE, KEY2 AS EQP_G, KEY3 AS EQP_ID, KEY4 AS CHAMBER_ID, KEY5 AS COMMON_ID, F_COMMENT AS TWINS_CHAMBER,UPDATE_TIME ,UPDATE_USER FROM PWEB.FUNCTION_SETTING T WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'Abnormal_System' AND FUNCTION_KEY = 'TwinsChamber' AND LINE = 'N11' UNION ALL SELECT LINE, KEY1 AS MODULE, KEY2 AS EQP_G, KEY3 AS EQP_ID, KEY4 AS CHAMBER_ID, KEY5 AS COMMON_ID, F_COMMENT AS TWINS_CHAMBER,UPDATE_TIME ,UPDATE_USER FROM A1MFG.V_FUNCTION_SETTING_A3 T WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'Abnormal_System' AND FUNCTION_KEY = 'TwinsChamber' AND LINE = 'N11' )B ON A.EQP_G=B.EQP_G AND A.EQP_ID=B.CHAMBER_ID ) WHERE PRODG_VALUE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LENGTH(PRODG_LABEL),PRODG_LABEL

SELECT C.*,D.PLATFORM_NICKNAME,E.PRODUCT_TYPE ,F.CT_G,F.PRODUCT_STATUS,G.CONTACT1_CNAME OWNER,G.DEPT_ID1 OWNER_DEPT FROM ( SELECT A.*,B.CHIPBODY FROM (SELECT DEPT_ID,PRODG1,ROUND(AVG(FOLLOW_RATE),1) FOLLOW_RATE FROM ( SELECT A.PRODG1,A.OPER_NO,A.EQP_G,A.DEPT_ID,A.SDEPT_CNAME ,CASE WHEN B.PRODUCT_STATUS IN ('Pilot','RISK') THEN A.FOLLOW_RATE ELSE A.NTO_FOLLOW_RATE END FOLLOW_RATE FROM (SELECT T1.PRODG1,T1.OPER_NO,T1.EQP_G,T1.FOLLOW_RATE,NVL(T2.NTO_FOLLOW_RATE,T1.NTO_FOLLOW_RATE) NTO_FOLLOW_RATE ,T1.DEPT_ID,T1.SDEPT_CNAME FROM ( SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_SUM_HIS WHERE CATEGORY='Pilot_TO_RISK' AND MFG_EQP_ID IS NOT NULL AND DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL )T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_SUM_HIS WHERE CATEGORY='NTO_TO_Pilot')T2 ON T1.PRODG1=T2.PRODG1 AND T1.OPER_NO=T2.OPER_NO UNION ALL SELECT T1.PRODG1,T1.OPER_NO,T1.EQP_G,T1.FOLLOW_RATE,NVL(T2.NTO_FOLLOW_RATE,T1.NTO_FOLLOW_RATE) NTO_FOLLOW_RATE ,T1.DEPT_ID,T1.SDEPT_CNAME FROM (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_SUM T WHERE T.MFG_EQP_ID IS NOT NULL AND T.DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL)T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_SUM_HIS WHERE CATEGORY='NTO_TO_Pilot')T2 ON T1.PRODG1=T2.PRODG1 AND T1.OPER_NO=T2.OPER_NO)A ,(SELECT PRODG,CHIPBODY,FAB,PRODUCT_STATUS ,INPUT_ACC,SHIPPED_DATE,CP_YIELD,FT_YIELD,HOBAN_LOT FROM A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN WHERE FLAG='Y' AND FAB IS NOT NULL AND IF_INPUTOVER200_FLAG IS NOT NULL)B WHERE A.PRODG1=B.PRODG )GROUP BY DEPT_ID,PRODG1 )A,A1MFG.NTO_PRODG_MAINTAIN B WHERE A.PRODG1=B.PRODG )C LEFT JOIN PWEB.product_platform D ON C.CHIPBODY=D.PRODSPEC_ID LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT E ON C.CHIPBODY=E.PRODSPEC_ID LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_INFO F ON C.PRODG1=F.PRODG1 LEFT JOIN PWEB.PRODUCT_OWNER G ON C.PRODG1=G.PRODG1 ORDER BY C.DEPT_ID
